current_patterns: NarrationPipeline runs only after SceneRuntime commits TurnResolution and receives a deep-copied session snapshot.
VectorContextStore is a protocol with retrieve and write_from_record, making storage implementations swappable.
NarrationValidator rejects invalid memory citations and prevents vector memory from being used as authoritative facts.
NarrationPromptBuilder labels vector memory and NarrativeState as non-authoritative auxiliary context.
Existing tests use small deterministic runtime fixtures and in-memory stores.
tech_debt: Persistent store currently has no corrupted JSONL recovery policy.
JSONL writes use whole-file rewrite and are not protected for concurrent writers.
SQLite graph memory is a local skeleton with no advanced traversal, ontology, migration versioning, or integration into NarrationPipeline.
ScenarioService still does not expose official memory search/list/forget endpoints.
Full online runtime smoke depends on external quota and can fail independently of local correctness.

architecture.decision_rationale: The feature fits the existing narration package seams: VectorContextStore already isolates non-authoritative memory retrieval/writeback, and the graph database can live beside it without touching runtime authority. Incremental changes minimize risk in a dirty worktree and preserve existing SceneRuntime behavior.

proposed_changes.description: Extend VectorMemoryMetadata with scope, lifecycle, provenance, timestamps, validity, supersession, tags, and forget reason while keeping default values for backward compatibility.
Add PersistentNarrationMemoryStore implementing VectorContextStore with JSONL load/save, search, soft forget, audit export, and conflict-aware retrieval.
Add SQLiteNarrationGraphMemory with entities/facts/edges schema, accepted patch ingestion, citation edges, supersession, search, and audit export.
Export the new persistent and graph memory classes from the narration package public API.
Test JSONL persistence, reload, retrieval, search, soft forget, and audit behavior.
Test graph fact ingestion, citation edges, entity/fact audit, search, and supersession validity windows.
Record implementation plan and verification commands for the feature.
Record formal MCP pipeline artifacts and subagent evidence for the redo.
